command: set -euo pipefail; TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega-install.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -rf -- "$TMP"' EXIT; git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$TMP"; cd "$TMP"; HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo SOURCE_HEAD=$HEAD; test "$HEAD" = 2319dcde91284c959837637d055e056e15137c70; bash scripts/install_voice_777_omega.sh; echo '--- READBACK ---'; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager; systemctl --user show frankenstein-chatgpt-client.service -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID -p ExecStart --no-pager; echo '--- HASHES ---'; for f in omega_arm_bus.py omega_organ_activity.py voice777_local_audio_arm.py voice777_omni_presence.py voice777_pocket_renderer.py voice_full_runtime.py frank_terminal.py voice_777_runtime.py voice_host_777_live_client.py frank_terminal_777.py; do printf '%s ' "$f"; sha256sum "$HOME/.local/lib/frankenstein/scripts/$f" | awk '{print $1}'; done; echo INSTALL_PASS=1
